verdict.rationale: Runloop ships an official CLI (`rli`) with both interactive TUI and traditional commands for managing devboxes, blueprints, SSH sessions, and benchmarks, documented directly in first-party docs and confirmed by probe. This is clearly built for AI-native/agentic workflows (blueprint creation, benchmark submission, devbox lifecycle management). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration beyond vendor docs, and no changelog/version history showing active CLI maintenance cadence.
